## Hi, I'm Yue Su

I am a graduate student specializing in Applied Business Analytics from Boston University, with a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management from Rutgers Business School.
 
With internship experience in both business analytics and logistics, I have developed a strong foundation in data analysis and problem-solving, and can analyze complex situations and identify practical solutions. I am particularly interested in leveraging data to support business decision-making and improve operational efficiency.
 
In addition, I have strong written communication skills and was selected to present an academic paper at a university-wide poster exhibition. This experience strengthened my ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.
